Name: ZH's Fancy Grub Additions
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/DkXTXKm.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]﻿
Want even more food to cook? How about those dishes that don't have a recipe? Why not something new, there's so many different types of dishes and foods out there after all. So why not add some to your game? That's what this mod does. Using both base game items or other mods' items as ingredients, you can create even more dishes.

﻿[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/OtOkbyL.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[u][b]Different bundles of recipes
[/b][/u]Recipes are grouped into themed bundles, to allow you to enable and disable what you do or not want. If a bundle theme is a particular mod, if you do not own that mod, the bundle will [b][u]automatically be not added[/u][/b] to your game

[center]﻿[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35132?tab=articles][size=3][u]Go to Articles to see in-depth guides for each bundle and recipe[/u][/size][u]﻿[/u][/url][/b][/center][b]Current bundles are:[/b]
[list]
[*]Base Game Add-Ons
[*]Cooked Meat Recipes (Requires either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28023]Rose's Cruelty Free Meat[/url]﻿)
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded (Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿)
[/list]
[u][b]Recipes for previously un-craftable food
[/b][/u]Now you can make those dishes yourself. No need to wait on Gus for your Piña Colada or Grampleton Orange Chicken, and you can use that Prismatic Shard to make your own Magic Rock Candy instead of waiting to get the right amount for the Desert Trader.

[u][b]Different Meat Options
[/b][/u]For recipes that call for meat ingredients, you can select whether you want to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28023]Rose's Cruelty Free Meat[/url] in the config. I've decided to use this config method to allow anyone that uses both mods together to choose what meat ingredient they want to use.

[u][b]Different Mod Compatibility
[/b][/u]Some recipes will change if it detects you are using particular mods. For example, if you are playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url], then the Roast Chicken recipe will change the oil ingredient to Rosemary.

[u][b]Highly Configurable
[/b][/u]This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/l2PH8KC.png[/img][/center]

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and any additional mod dependancies you wish to add (However, this is [b]NOT required[/b] to play).﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play
